# BrandLockup

The compass-arrow mark with the NAVRYA wordmark and the character edition line — the only approved brand lockup.

```jsx
<BrandLockup character="commander" orientation="horizontal" markSize={40} />
```

- `orientation="vertical"` is the header lockup (200px brand region); `horizontal` is the sidebar strip.
- The mark wedge already carries the character colour — never recolour the mark in CSS.
- Wordmark is Cinzel at .22em tracking. Never set NAVRYA in the UI font.
